title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Calculation of Compensation for Loss and the Period of Infringement in Cases of Trademark Infringement

articles.content_en: 1. In cases of infringement of the exclusive right to use a trademark, the infringed party may request compensation based on the amount of actual losses suffered. The infringed party may also request that the profits gained by the infringer during the infringement period due to the infringement (referring to all profits except costs and taxes) be taken as the amount of compensation. The infringed party shall have the right to choose between the above two calculation methods.

2. Regarding the calculation of the period for claiming damages, if the infringement occurred before the implementation of the Trademark Law and continued after its implementation, the infringement period shall be calculated from the date of implementation of the Trademark Law (March 1, 1993); if the infringement occurred after the implementation of the Trademark Law, it shall be calculated from the date of infringement.
